svg.title: F03 Apply to be a driver or vehicle owner

g.text: Apply to be a driver or vehicle owner

text.tspan: Prototype: SMS/email and the GCash gateway are not connected.
An administrator reviews every application, meets you for an interview and gives an orientation before activating a role. Required documents
can be changed by the company.

g.text: Any customer can apply by uploading documents.
Staff verify, interview and orient applicants
License, ID, clearance, proof of address.
